policy: Fail closed. An image is only shipped if it is cleared. 'blocked' files must never appear in a release build (owner-approved: the AI-generated cinematic set and the older archway photos, whose provenance is unverified). 'unverified' is a holding category for files awaiting a decision: a release build must not reference them, and they are reported when present. Pinned by SHA-256, so deleting or renaming the source files does not unblock them. The source files stay in the repository for development. See docs/ARTWORK-RELEASE.md.
